title: Norms Adventure
welcome_lead: Why do we queue, shake hands, take shoes off? Meet norms. 📏
meta_desc: Norms & Values Adventure 1 — KS3 Sociology on social norms and breaking them.
final_note: You learned what norms are and what happens when they're broken.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Norms are the unwritten rules of behaviour:

  • Queue at the bus stop.
  • Don't talk loudly in a library.
  • Shake hands when introduced.

Nobody had to teach them in school. You picked them up.

Break a norm = deviance.

Possible sanctions:

  • A funny look.
  • A 'tut'.
  • Being left out.
  • Sometimes formal — a fine.

Norms vary across the world:

  • Bowing in Japan.
  • Removing shoes inside in many homes.
  • Burping after a meal seen as polite in some places.

What's 'normal' is cultural. 🌏
